decisions.reason: The accepted refund policy applies to excess value produced by swapping an ETH payment; it does not change the direct connected-wallet USDC mint flow.
Refunding swap proceeds above the $15 mint price does not alter the existing $15 revenue allocation or any allocation recipient.
The candidate's ETH payment-asset requirement remains valid unchanged; excess-value handling is independently owned by the source refund-policy Requirement.
The refund decision changes neither which payment methods are selectable nor how supported currencies are disclosed.
The decision concerns excess USDC resulting from an ETH-to-USDC swap and does not change the deferred Transak fiat conversion and mint flow.
The ETH excess-refund policy does not change whether tipping is available or its preset and custom-tip options.
Handling excess ETH swap proceeds does not change the rule that only successful mint transactions are recorded and counted.
The refund policy does not alter the condition under which the Mint Successful modal may be displayed.
The accepted ETH refund behavior does not change wallet creation, custody, destination, or access rules for fiat buyers.
The NFT remains an unlimited-mint ebook priced at $15; refunding ETH-derived USDC above that price does not modify the offering model.
The source accepts contract refund behavior but does not instruct that the FAQ be revised, and its existing $15-price statement remains valid.
Returning ETH-swap proceeds above the mint price does not change the Small Block prize amount, cadence, eligibility, or pool-funding rules.
